summary_en: Airtech Japan updates its capital cost and share-price conscious management framework (Vol.3). Board resolution on current-state analysis and forward execution policy. Specific metrics and targets in attached reference material.
title_en: Initiatives toward Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: Airtech Japan (6291, TSE Standard) announced on 12 August 2026 an update (Vol.3) to its capital cost and share-price conscious management framework, which was originally published on 14 August 2025. The board of directors held a meeting on this date and resolved on an analysis of the company's current state and the direction of future initiatives in this area. The detailed content of the update, including specific metrics, targets, and execution plans, is contained in the attached reference material (not reproduced in the first two pages of the disclosure).
